title: Unggahan Persiapan Tim
attacker_character: bukan penipu — ini kawan tim yang ceroboh soal privasi (kesalahan manusia, bukan scam)
attacker_goal: menggiring korban ikut membocorkan data pribadi di unggahan publik
opener: Foto persiapan tim kamu keren banget! Kartu pelajar dan jadwal latihan kelihatan jelas — ayo upload ke Instagram biar semua orang lihat perjuangan kita!
escalation_ladder: ajakan unggah foto berisi kartu pelajar + jadwal
cuci tangan 'yang penting eksis, tidak apa-apa'
upload duluan tanpa izin lalu minta kamu ikut
red_flags: kartu pelajar (nama lengkap + NISN) terlihat di foto
akun tidak private → siapa pun bisa lihat
safe_response: blur/tutup kartu pelajar sebelum unggah, jadwal tidak perlu dipublikasikan, batasi akun ke kenalan saja
lesson: Data yang tampak sepele (kartu pelajar, jadwal) bisa dipakai penipu untuk menyusun cerita meyakinkan. Sebelum unggah, tanya: apa yang terlihat di foto ini?

en.title: Team Prep Post
en.attacker_character: not a scammer — a careless teammate about privacy (human error, not fraud)
en.opener: Your team prep photo looks awesome! Your student ID and practice schedule are clearly visible — let's upload it to Instagram so everyone sees our grind!
escalation_ladder: pushes to post a photo revealing student ID + schedule
pressure: 'every other team is posting too'
uploads it without asking, then pushes you to join
red_flags: student ID (full name + ID number) visible in the photo
account not private → anyone can view
en.safe_response: blur/cover the student ID before posting, schedules don't need publishing, restrict the account to people you know
en.lesson: Seemingly harmless data (student ID, schedules) lets scammers build convincing stories. Before posting, ask: what can be seen in this photo?
